name: 濒死免疫
description: 飞段处于「濒死」状态时，免疫所有伤害
skillCode: var hidan = context.rulePiece; if (context.piece.instanceId !== hidan.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var inDying = hidan.statusTags && hidan.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'hidan-dying'; }); if (!inDying) return { success: false, message: '' }; var damage = context.damage || 0; if (damage > 0) { var oathed = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== hidan.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0 && p.statusTags && p.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'blood-oath'; }); }); if (oathed) { dealDamage(hidan, oathed, damage, 'true', battle, 'blood-oath-reflect-dying'); return { success: true, blocked: true, message: hidan.name + '处于濒死状态，免疫' + damage + '点伤害，但诅咒将' + damage + '点反射给' + oathed.name }; } } return { success: true, blocked: true, message: hidan.name + '处于濒死状态，免疫伤害' };
